name: Exp_ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle custom indicator, which is a Schaff Trend Cycle variant built on TriX momentum. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from high color values (>5) downward and sell positions when it transitions from low color values (<2) upward, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle（基于TriX动量的Schaff趋势周期变体）进行交易。当指标从高色值（>5）向下穿越时开多仓，从低色值（<2）向上穿越时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle指标，这是一个结合TriX三重指数平滑动量和Schaff趋势周期算法的复合动量指标。入场条件为：当指标颜色值从大于5的区域下穿至小于6时开多仓，表示动量从超买区回落但仍偏多；当指标颜色值从小于2的区域上穿至大于1时开空仓，表示动量从超卖区回升但仍偏空。出场条件由独立的买卖平仓标志控制，当反向信号出现时触发平仓。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于自由保证金百分比等模式，通过MarginMode枚举参数选择。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，配合1000点止损和2000点止盈实现2:1的盈亏比。EA还包含新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复交易，并有指标数据就绪检查防止未计算完成时下单。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle indicator, a composite momentum indicator combining TriX triple exponential smoothing momentum with the Schaff Trend Cycle algorithm. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the indicator color value crosses down from above 5 to below 6, signaling momentum easing from overbought but still bullish; a sell position opens when the color value crosses up from below 2 to above 1, signaling momentum recovering from oversold but still bearish. Exit conditions are controlled by independent buy/sell close flags triggered when opposing signals appear. Position sizing supports multiple modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage, selectable via the MarginMode enum parameter. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter at a default 0.1 risk ratio, combined with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit for a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio. The EA also includes a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar and an indicator readiness check to prevent orders before calculation completes.

parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：固定手数、余额百分比、自由保证金百分比等

pros: 使用Schaff趋势周期与TriX动量复合指标，信号经过双重平滑过滤，减少假信号
提供多种仓位管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
止损止盈设置合理，默认2:1盈亏比，有利于长期正期望值
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
买卖开关独立控制，可灵活启用/禁用单方向交易
pros_en: Uses a composite Schaff Trend Cycle + TriX momentum indicator with double smoothing, reducing false signals
Provides multiple position sizing modes with high flexibility for different risk preferences
Reasonable stop loss and take profit with default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, supporting long-term positive expectancy
New bar detection prevents duplicate entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Independent buy/sell enable switches allow flexible single-direction trading
cons: 依赖自定义指标文件，指标逻辑不透明，难以回测验证信号质量
无点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
止损1000点和止盈2000点较大，对账户资金要求高，小资金账户难以承受
指标颜色值阈值（5和2）的硬编码逻辑不够直观，缺乏详细注释说明
未包含追踪止损功能，盈利头寸可能因回撤而大幅缩水后才触及止盈
cons_en: Depends on a custom indicator file with opaque logic, making it hard to independently backtest signal quality
No spread filter mechanism, potentially entering at unfavorable prices in high-spread conditions
Large 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP require significant account capital, challenging for small accounts
Hardcoded indicator color thresholds (5 and 2) are unintuitive with insufficient documentation
No trailing stop feature, profitable positions may significantly retrace before hitting take profit
improvements: 增加点差过滤条件，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，避免不利入场
添加追踪止损功能，在盈利达到一定程度后锁定利润
将指标颜色阈值参数化，允许用户自定义超买超卖水平而非硬编码
增加最大持仓数量限制和最大回撤保护，增强风控能力
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause opening positions when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable entries
Implement a trailing stop to lock in profits once a position reaches a certain gain level
Parameterize the indicator color thresholds to allow user-defined overbought/oversold levels instead of hardcoding
Add maximum position count limits and maximum drawdown protection to enhance risk management

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标缺失或版本不匹配可能导致交易信号错误
止损1000点较大，单笔亏损可能较显著，尤其在小资金账户上
无点差过滤和最大回撤保护，在极端行情下可能连续亏损
risk_points_en: Depends on external custom indicator file; missing or mismatched version may cause incorrect trading signals
1000-point stop loss is relatively large, single-trade loss can be significant especially on small accounts
No spread filter or maximum drawdown protection, risking consecutive losses in extreme market conditions
